name: 27618-shortdecode-opt125m-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=200, warmup the first 10% by completion, bounded at 50000 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, `request_format: plain` against /v1/completions. Prompt exactly 48 tokens, output exactly 10, `ignore_eos` on, temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0.
purpose: A compact autocomplete assistant returning ten-token suggestions for 48-token prompts, serving 200 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: facebook/opt-125m
dtype: float16
tensor-parallel-size: 1
swap-space: 16
async-scheduling: true

# Pinned above the declared 200 concurrent streams: the library fallbacks are 128 seqs and
# 2048 batched tokens, and 128 would cap the running batch below the declared operating point.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 2048
enable-prefix-caching: true
